title: Yellow Spanish Chicken Tapas Platter
description: A fresh and tender Spanish dish featuring ground annatto, perfect for a kid-friendly meal, this tapas platter is low in carbs and full of flavor
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, ground annatto, olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper
Thread the chicken mixture onto skewers, if desired
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Bake the chicken for 20 minutes, or until cooked through
While the chicken is baking, mix the lemon juice with a little water to make a glaze
After the chicken has baked for 15 minutes, brush the lemon glaze over the top of the chicken
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving
To serve, place the chicken on a large tagliere or platter, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh herbs
